## Completed example

**Paper:** Validated workflow for monitoring athlete-reported recovery; methods article for applied researchers and practitioners.

| Check | Candidate A | Candidate B |
|---|---|---|
| Scope/readers | methods and applied practice; three relevant papers verified | broad sport scope; invitation mentions wrong study topic |
| Review/transparency | process, editor and corrections policy clearly stated | review time guaranteed; board affiliations partly unverifiable |
| Cost/rights | no mandatory fee; accepted manuscript may be deposited | fee appears only in submission FAQ; repository right unclear |
| Reporting | accepts validation studies and names relevant checklist | no method-specific instructions found |
| Decision | preferred: verified fit and feasible thesis timing | pause: unresolved process, fee and rights |

**Evidence of done:** All authors approve Candidate A and the exact manuscript package; URLs and 28 August 2026 check date are retained. Candidate B is not labelled fraudulent—only insufficiently verified.

## Scenario test

A supervisor recommends their usual journal, but its current policy conflicts with the funder's repository requirement. Do not rely on historic experience. Confirm whether another licence or repository route resolves the conflict; otherwise compare another outlet and record the displacement.

## Stop conditions

Pause submission if fees, rights, peer review, publisher identity, author agreement, reporting duties or confidentiality conditions remain materially unclear.
